english_short.description: Short English sentences from the existing evaluation corpus.

multilingual_short.description: Short multilingual and mixed-script inputs from the existing evaluation corpus.

mixed_short.description: Stable mixed English/multilingual M5 batch workload (132 source items before sampling).

unicode_edge.description: Emoji, combining forms, bidirectional text, and unusual Unicode sequences.

vocab_spread.description: Diverse scripts and symbol domains intended to spread token-embedding row access.

medium.description: Medium-length paragraph inputs between short sentences and the model context cap.

long_context.description: Existing inputs designed to saturate the 512-token context cap.

uniform_len.description: Synthetic control: every sentence is a distinct permutation of the same seven words, so all sentences tokenize to an identical token count and length-sorted sub-batches carry zero padding at every batch size. Used to separate padding cost from activation cache cost in the warm batch matrix.
